settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A purple bearbrick 1000% in a rich purple finish with custom branding and a QR code on the chest. A bold collectible centrepiece and branded display piece.
settings.s1_body: This designer-style bearbrick figure is a blank canvas turned statement piece - finished here in deep purple with custom branding and a scannable QR code on the chest. It makes a striking collectible, a branded retail display or a standout corporate gift. We finish it in any colourway, artwork and branding you like.
settings.case_body: Produced as a branded collectible, this purple figure paired a recognisable designer-toy silhouette with custom branding and a QR code - ideal for a brand activation, retail display or premium gift.
settings.case_quote: Such a cool, on-brand piece. The QR code on the chest was a clever touch everyone noticed.
settings.prov_p: A designer bearbrick figure is a magnet for attention. Finished in your colours and branding, it becomes a collectible that quietly markets you wherever it sits.
